title: Singapore Botanic Gardens (UNESCO World Heritage Site, 1859)

cores.name: Core 1 — Tanglin Core (1859 Historic Heritage Core)
cores.description: Historic 1859 pleasure grounds featuring Tanglin Silver Gate, Swan Lake, the 1930 Octagonal Bandstand, the $5-Note Tembusu Tree, and Holttum Hall.

cores.name: Core 2 — Central Core (National Orchid Garden & Palm Valley)
cores.description: Mid-spine heart with Nassim Gate Visitor Centre, Symphony Lake & Shaw Stage, National Orchid Garden (Burkill Hall, Cool House, Mist House), Ginger Waterfall, and 6-ha Primary Rainforest.

cores.name: Core 3 — Tyersall–Gallop Extension (Learning Forest & Colonial Ridges)
cores.description: South-West forest wing with Keppel Discovery Wetlands, SPH Walk of Giants Canopy Boardwalk, 1898 Atbara House, 1906 Inverturret Gallery, and COMO Adventure Grove.

cores.name: Core 4 — Bukit Timah Core (Eco-Lake & Jacob Ballas Children's Garden)
cores.description: Northern academic and family core anchored by Eco-Lake Black-Necked Swans Sanctuary, Foliage & Evolution Garden, Jacob Ballas Children's Garden, and Bukit Timah MRT Gate.
